wanted.title: You Were On My Mind This Morning

candidate.song_name: You Were On My Mind This Morning

content:
[Verse]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                        [ch]C[/ch]
You were on my mind this morning, you were on my mind today.[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                        [ch]C[/ch]
We had our good times together, we sure had our special ways.[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                                                  [ch]C[/ch]
I guess those happy days are gone now, just like water through my hands.[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                                  [ch]C[/ch]
Wonder if I'll ever see you, ever kiss your lips again.[/tab]

[Instrumental]
  [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch]     
  [ch]D[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]D[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch]     

[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                       [ch]C[/ch]
If you hear me and I'm singing, some old lonesome song like this.[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                       [ch]C[/ch]
You'll know I'm not over you and I am longing for your kiss.[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                                           [ch]C[/ch]
Wish that I could linger longer, sit down in some evening shade.[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                                             [ch]C[/ch]
But you know I have to ramble, guess that's just the way I'm made.[/tab]

[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                        [ch]C[/ch]
You were on my mind this morning, you were on my mind today.[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                        [ch]C[/ch]

  [ch]D[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]D[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch] 

[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                       [ch]C[/ch]
Things were going good and I was flush and I was fancy fine,[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                      [ch]C[/ch]
threw it all away on women, whiskey, cards, dice, and wine.[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                                     [ch]C[/ch]
I will roll and I will tumble, I will rise and fall again.[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                                   [ch]C[/ch]
Ridin' on this roller coaster, doesn't ever seem to end.[/tab]

  [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch]

I would leave this town this morning, I would leave this town today,[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                     [ch]C[/ch]
If I thought you'd have me back I would soon be on my way.[/tab]

[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                                   [ch]C[/ch]
